tagline: Sync sales meetings with Salesforce and auto-log CRM activity from your calendar
metaTitle: Google Calendar + Salesforce Integration: Meeting Logging
metaDescription: Prep for sales calls in seconds. GAIA briefs you from Salesforce before each calendar meeting and logs it as an activity afterwards. See the setup steps.
intro:
Every sales call on your Google Calendar should have a corresponding activity record in Salesforce — but manually logging each meeting after it happens is one of the most resisted tasks in the sales profession. Reps log calls inconsistently, details get forgotten by end of day, and managers lose the pipeline visibility they need to coach effectively. The CRM timeline becomes a fiction rather than an accurate record.

GAIA connects the two to make CRM logging automatic. When a sales meeting appears on your calendar, GAIA links it to the relevant opportunity, contact, or account. When the meeting ends, GAIA creates the activity record with attendees, duration, and a summary derived from any notes you've added. Follow-up tasks from the call land in Salesforce Tasks automatically so the next step is always recorded.

This integration is designed for account executives who want accurate CRM records without the administrative friction, for sales managers who need consistent pipeline activity data across the team, and for RevOps teams who build reporting on top of activity logs that are currently incomplete.

useCases.title: Auto-log calendar meetings as Salesforce activities
useCases.description: When a meeting with a known contact ends, GAIA creates an activity record with the meeting details, duration, and attendees automatically.

useCases.title: Pre-meeting contact briefing
useCases.description: Fifteen minutes before a sales call, GAIA pulls the contact's recent activity, open opportunities, and last interaction date from Salesforce so you walk in fully prepared.

useCases.title: Follow-up task creation from sales calls
useCases.description: After a calendar meeting linked to an opportunity, GAIA creates follow-up tasks in the CRM (send proposal, update stage, schedule next call) based on a configurable template.

useCases.title: Opportunity next step updates
useCases.description: GAIA updates the Next Step field on the linked opportunity after each calendar meeting, recording the agreed action so pipeline reviews reflect the latest discussion.

useCases.title: Meeting cadence monitoring
useCases.description: GAIA detects opportunities with no meeting scheduled in the past 14 days and creates a task to re-engage, preventing deals from stalling silently.

howItWorks.step: Connect Google Calendar and Salesforce to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your Google account and your Salesforce org in GAIA's settings. GAIA uses Connected App OAuth and the calendar API to read and write both sides.

howItWorks.step: Configure meeting matching and logging rules
howItWorks.description: Tell GAIA how to match calendar attendees to contacts, which calendar event types should create activity records, and what follow-up task templates to apply.

howItWorks.step: GAIA logs activities and tasks automatically
howItWorks.description: After each qualifying calendar event, GAIA creates the activity record and any follow-up tasks within minutes of the meeting ending, keeping your CRM current.

faqs.question: How does GAIA match calendar attendees to contacts?
faqs.answer: Matching is by email address. If an attendee's email matches a contact or lead record, GAIA links the activity to that record. Unmatched attendees are flagged for manual review.

faqs.question: Will GAIA log internal meetings as well as external sales calls?
faqs.answer: You can configure it to log only meetings with external domains, only meetings where a CRM contact is an attendee, or all meetings. Internal-only meetings can be excluded.

faqs.question: Does this require Salesforce admin access?
faqs.answer: Individual reps need standard user access with API permissions enabled. For org-wide deployment, an admin needs to set up the Connected App.

faqs.question: Can GAIA update the opportunity stage based on the meeting?
faqs.answer: It can update the stage if you configure a rule — for example, a meeting tagged as 'Demo' advances the opportunity to Demonstration. Stage changes require your approval before they are applied.
